title: Only design tokens are declared in the theme's :root; internal hooks are not

v:
# Only design tokens are declared in the theme's `:root`; internal hooks are not

## Context

ADR-0014 (decision `01M4GA3EJMHKCWGHEC7ZJX0SGZ`) and CONTEXT.md say that `default.css`'s single
`:root` block is the whole of the theme's styling interface. siren-website takes that literally: it
derives its Theme (panel fields, the `.siren.css` export, the theme page) from the `:root`
declarations and guards the derivation with tests. Its report on the theme tokens found that
`:root` declared 31 custom properties while `packages/core/README.md`'s token table listed 26.
The difference was the five `--siren-edge-march*` properties the animated edge brought in. Four of
them (`-dash`, `-offset`, `-fast-duration`, `-slow-duration`) are real theme values. The fifth,
`--siren-edge-march`, is a hook core uses internally: `.siren-edge-animation-fast/-slow` set it
on the edge element itself, so a value redeclared in `:root` never reaches an animated edge, and an
edge without the animation never reads it. Declaring it in `:root` contradicted ADR-0014 and gave
the website's Theme a field that does nothing when changed. Nothing in core checked that the
README table matched `:root`.

## Decision

1. A **design token** is a value a theme can redeclare and have take effect. `:root` declares only
   design tokens.
2. A custom property that passes a value between core's own rules — an **internal hook**, such as
   `--siren-edge-march` — is not a design token and is not declared in `:root`. Every read of it
   carries its own default as `var(--x, <fallback>)`, and what sets it is core's own class or media
   query.
3. The four `--siren-edge-march-*` properties are design tokens in the Motion group.

## Consequences

- `:root` declares 30 tokens, all of them design tokens; `--siren-edge-march` is not among them.
- Every read of the hook is written `var(--siren-edge-march, none)`; `.siren-edge-animation-fast/-slow`
  and the `prefers-reduced-motion` rule still set it, so animated edges behave exactly as before.
- The README token table lists the same 30 tokens, and a test fails when the table and `:root`
  disagree in either direction, naming the missing and extra names.
- A consumer deriving a theme from `:root` gets exactly the set of values that can be overridden.
  A future internal hook follows rule 2 rather than being added to `:root`.
- ADR-0014's text is unchanged; it and its markdown copy carry a pointer to this decision.
